findings.current: There was not the slightest hesitation in his hand.
findings.defect: The pronoun can refer to Jeok Cheongang, the immediately preceding subject, rather than Jangcheon, whose hand killed the captive.
findings.rationale: The Korean describes Jangcheon’s unhesitating hand immediately after Jeok Cheongang watches the blood erupt. Naming Jangcheon preserves the action’s subject without ambiguity, as the baseline did.
findings.replacement: There was not the slightest hesitation in Jangcheon’s hand.

summary: Faithful overall, with one minor subject-clarity regression.
